column2: Back
column3: Extra

column2:
核心义：浸润于，充满。
本义：steep 可指把东西浸泡在液体里。
引申义：某地、组织或领域长期浸润在某种传统、文化、精神或氛围中。
语气：文雅、书面，比 be full of 更有历史厚度。
column3:
文章语境：Cambridge is steeped in innovation. 作者不是说剑桥“有创新”，而是说创新像传统一样渗透其中。
暗示：创新不是偶然事件，而是长期积累出的城市气质。
例句1 教育：A great university should be steeped in curiosity and intellectual discipline.
例句2 文化：A city steeped in tradition can still embrace modern technology.
例句3 作文：Contemporary society is steeped in digital innovation, but it also needs ethical reflection.
可用场景：教育学习、传统文化、科技创新、城市发展。

column2:
核心义：同名者，同名地。
引申义：名字相同但身份、地位、发展路径可能不同的人或地方。
语气：新闻和文化类文章常用，用来引出比较或历史渊源。
column3:
文章语境：American namesake 指美国马萨诸塞州剑桥，与英国剑桥同名。
暗示：同名不只是巧合，而是历史、教育和文化联系。
例句1 文化：The American city shares both its name and academic ambition with its British namesake.
例句2 品牌：A product may borrow the prestige of its famous namesake, but it must prove its own value.
例句3 写作：Cultural influence can travel across borders and reappear in a distant namesake.
可用场景：文化交流、历史渊源、城市比较、品牌命名。

column1: not so much A as B
column2:
核心义：与其说 A，不如说 B。
语法：重点不是完全否定 A，而是强调 B 更准确。
语气：高级转折，适合纠正表面理解。
column3:
文章语境：American Cambridge has not so much imitated its British cousin as surpassed it. 作者强调美国剑桥不只是模仿，而是超越。
暗示：美国创新生态已经从继承者变成领先者。
例句1 教育：Online learning has not so much replaced classrooms as expanded what education can be.
例句2 科技：AI has not so much removed human judgment as made it more important.
例句3 职场：A good job has not so much given me comfort as forced me to grow.
可用场景：科技双刃剑、教育改革、个人成长、社会变化。

column2:
核心义：镜像，彼此像镜子里的对应物。
引申义：表面相似，但方向、问题或结构相反。
语气：形象对比，适合写议论文结构。
column3:
文章语境：The two Cambridges are mirror images: on the surface almost identical, but with opposite problems. 两地都强创新，但短板相反。
暗示：文章不是简单排名，而是结构性比较。
例句1 教育：Urban and rural schools can be mirror images: one has resources but pressure, the other has freedom but fewer opportunities.
例句2 科技：Two platforms may be mirror images, sharing the same users but creating opposite social effects.
例句3 作文：Modern life often presents mirror images of progress: more convenience, but less patience.
可用场景：对比论证、城市发展、教育公平、科技影响。

column2:
核心义：抵消弱点，弥补短板。
熟词辟义：offset 可作动词，表示用一方抵消另一方。
语气：经济、管理、合作语境常用。
column3:
文章语境：两个剑桥更紧密合作 to offset weaknesses。合作不是情怀，而是互补短板。
暗示：真正有效的合作来自互补，而不只是相似。
例句1 学习：Group study can offset individual weaknesses if members have different strengths.
例句2 职场：A strong team offsets weaknesses through complementary skills.
例句3 经济：Public investment can offset weaknesses in private capital markets.
可用场景：团队合作、教育学习、区域合作、经济政策。

column2:
核心义：连接在一起的，结合的。
引申义：关系越来越紧密，难以完全分开。
语气：比 connected 更强，带结构性绑定意味。
column3:
文章语境：The relationship is unequal, but increasingly conjoined. 两个剑桥不对等，但越来越相连。
暗示：合作不是完全平等的联盟，而是互相依赖的结构。
例句1 经济：Education and employment are increasingly conjoined in the modern economy.
例句2 科技：Technology and daily life have become deeply conjoined.
例句3 写作：Personal freedom and social responsibility are conjoined rather than opposed.
可用场景：科技生活、教育就业、社会责任、国际合作。

column2:
核心义：创新引擎。
引申义：持续产生新技术、新公司、新人才和新产业的系统。
语气：经济报道和政策文本常用。
column3:
文章语境：两个剑桥都是 efficient innovation engines。作者强调它们不是单个大学，而是能持续产出的系统。
暗示：创新靠生态，不靠孤立天才。
例句1 教育：Universities can become innovation engines when research is connected with society.
例句2 城市：A city becomes an innovation engine when talent, capital and infrastructure interact.
例句3 作文：Education is the most reliable innovation engine for long-term national development.
可用场景：教育强国、科技创新、城市发展、经济转型。

column2:
核心义：在某方面略占优势。
语气：比较时常用，通常不是绝对碾压，而是相对领先。
搭配：have the edge in research / quality / speed / experience。
column3:
文章语境：Britain's Cambridge may have the edge in research. 英国剑桥科研更强，但商业化不如波士顿。
暗示：优势是局部的，不能推出整体更强。
例句1 教育：Traditional classrooms still have the edge in discipline and face-to-face interaction.
例句2 科技：Small firms may have the edge in flexibility, while large firms have more resources.
例句3 作文：A country can have the edge in research but still lag behind in application.
可用场景：对比论证、教育方式、科技竞争、职场能力。

column2:
核心义：将科研成果商业化。
引申义：把知识、实验室成果或发明转化为产品、企业和市场价值。
语气：中性偏积极，但也可能引出学术与商业的张力。
column3:
文章语境：Boston commercialises it better. 波士顿不一定科研更密集，但更会把科研变成产业。
暗示：知识本身不等于社会影响，转化能力也关键。
例句1 教育：Universities should commercialise research without sacrificing academic independence.
例句2 科技：A discovery changes society only when it can be commercialised responsibly.
例句3 经济：Countries that fail to commercialise research may lose the value of their own inventions.
可用场景：科技创新、大学功能、经济发展、社会责任。

column2:
核心义：受制于，被……限制。
语气：正式，常用于结构性限制，不只是个人困难。
搭配：constrained by resources / infrastructure / rules / time / tradition。
column3:
文章语境：Cambridge remains constrained by its medieval skin. 作者用 medieval skin 形象说明老城空间限制创新扩张。
暗示/诙谐：历史底蕴既是魅力，也是束缚。
例句1 教育：Many students are constrained by limited access to quality resources.
例句2 城市：Historic cities are often constrained by old infrastructure.
例句3 个人：A person should not be constrained by past failures.
可用场景：教育公平、城市发展、个人成长、经济转型。

column2:
核心义：中世纪外壳。
引申义：历史城市的旧空间、旧街区、旧基础设施。
语气：形象、略带诙谐：把城市比作有一层老皮肤。
column3:
文章语境：the real Cambridge remains constrained by its medieval skin. 剑桥的历史风貌限制住房、水、交通和实验室空间。
暗示：传统不是纯粹加分项，也可能限制现代创新。
例句1 文化：A city should protect its historical skin without letting it block modern life.
例句2 科技：Innovation cannot thrive if it is trapped in a medieval skin of outdated infrastructure.
例句3 作文：Tradition should be preserved, but not allowed to become a skin that prevents renewal.
可用场景：传统文化创新、城市发展、环境规划、科技基础设施。

column2:
核心义：严重缺乏，得不到足够供应。
本义：starve = 挨饿。
引申义：资金、空间、人才、关注、资源等被“饿着”。
语气：比 lack 强烈，形象。
column3:
文章语境：Britain's Cambridge is starved of capital and space. 英国剑桥不是一般缺，而是发展被资源饥饿限制。
暗示：科研强但成长营养不足。
例句1 教育：Rural schools are often starved of qualified teachers.
例句2 创业：Promising startups may fail if they are starved of long-term capital.
例句3 个人：Young people starved of encouragement may lose confidence.
可用场景：教育资源、经济发展、心理成长、科技创新。

column2:
核心义：缺乏，匮乏。
语气：正式书面，常接抽象资源。
搭配：a dearth of capital / evidence / talent / trust / imagination。
column3:
文章语境：a dearth of domestic capital later on means firms fall behind as they grow. 后期本土资本不足导致企业成长受限。
暗示：早期热闹不代表能长大，长期支持更重要。
例句1 教育：A dearth of reading habits can weaken students' language ability.
例句2 社会：A dearth of trust makes public cooperation difficult.
例句3 科技：A dearth of patient capital can slow the commercialisation of research.
可用场景：教育学习、社会信任、科技创新、经济发展。

column2:
核心义：概念验证，初步证明想法可行。
技术/创业语境：不是最终产品，而是证明方向能跑通。
语气：商业、技术、科研高频。
column3:
文章语境：疫情期间美国一些公司 often without proof of concept 就过早 IPO。
暗示：资本过热会让尚未验证的想法过早进入市场。
例句1 科技：A new technology should not be scaled up without proof of concept.
例句2 教育：Pilot programmes can provide proof of concept before reform is expanded nationwide.
例句3 职场：A small project can serve as proof of concept for a larger plan.
可用场景：科技创新、教育改革、创业、项目管理。

column2:
核心义：规避风险的，风险厌恶的。
语气：经济金融常用，不一定贬义；但过度 risk-averse 会抑制创新。
搭配：risk-averse investors / parents / institutions / students。
column3:
文章语境：Investors became more risk-averse, giving larger amounts to fewer firms. 投资人更谨慎，把钱集中给少数公司。
暗示：市场低迷后，资本不是消失，而是更挑剔。
例句1 教育：Overly risk-averse students may avoid challenges that help them grow.
例句2 投资：Risk-averse investors prefer proven business models.
例句3 作文：A society that is too risk-averse may fail to encourage creativity.
可用场景：个人品质、创新精神、职场发展、经济生活。

column2:
核心义：相互补充。
引申义：两个事物不是替代关系，而是各自弥补对方短板。
语气：积极、理性，适合写平衡观点。
column3:
文章语境：two Cambridges' strengths and weaknesses seem to complement one another. 英国科研强、美国商业化强，正好互补。
暗示：合作来自结构互补，不是单纯友好。
例句1 教育：Online learning and traditional classrooms can complement one another.
例句2 职场：Technical skills and communication skills complement one another.
例句3 文化：Tradition and innovation can complement one another if handled wisely.
可用场景：教育、职场、文化交流、科技发展。

column2:
核心义：吸引人才。
熟词辟义：lure 本义有“诱饵、引诱”，比 attract 更有策略性和竞争意味。
语气：新闻英语，常用于城市、公司、国家争夺人才。
column3:
文章语境：美国削减公共研究经费 may help Britain lure across talent. 英国可能趁机吸引人才跨洋而来。
政治意味：人才流动受国家政策影响，是国际竞争的一部分。
例句1 职场：Companies lure talent with flexible work and meaningful projects.
例句2 教育：World-class universities can lure talent from around the globe.
例句3 国家竞争：Stable research funding helps a country lure and retain scientific talent.
可用场景：职场发展、教育强国、科技竞争、城市吸引力。

column2:
核心义：前者……，后者……。
语法：former 指前面两个对象中的第一个；latter 指第二个。
功能：避免重复名词，让比较更紧凑。
column3:
文章语境：The former offers access to America's capital and market; the latter, world-class talent on the cheap. 前者指美国办公室，后者指英国本土研发。
例句1 教育：Online courses offer flexibility; traditional classrooms offer discipline. The former saves time; the latter builds routine.
例句2 职场：Hard skills and soft skills are both necessary. The former helps one do the job; the latter helps one work with people.
例句3 写作：Economic growth and environmental protection should not be opposed. The former creates resources; the latter protects the future.
可用场景：所有对比类作文。

column2: 中心论点：顶级创新生态不只靠大学和科研，还需要资本、基础设施、市场、临床试验能力和跨区域合作。英国剑桥科研强但资源受限，美国剑桥商业化强但受资本泡沫影响，二者正在互补。
column3:
可背作文论点：Innovation depends not only on talent, but also on institutions, infrastructure and long-term support.
例句1：A successful city turns knowledge into social value by connecting education, capital and public services.
例句2：Research can change the world only when ideas are supported by patient capital and practical infrastructure.
例句3：Cooperation works best when different sides complement, rather than duplicate, one another.
适用话题：教育学习、科技创新、经济发展、职场生活、文化交流。

column2:
核心义：塑造，影响……的形成。
熟词辟义：shape 不只是“形状”，作动词表示长期塑造。
语气：教育、文化、历史、人格话题高频。
column3:
文章语境：Its university shaped Milton, Darwin and Hawking。
例句1：Education shapes not only knowledge but also character.
例句2：Family, school and society shape a young person's values.
可用场景：教育学习、精神品质、文化影响。

column2:
核心义：标明……发生的地点。
语气：历史叙述常用。
搭配：a plaque marks where...
column3:
文章语境：A plaque outside the Eagle pub marks where DNA discovery was announced。
例句1：A museum can mark where important cultural exchanges began.
例句2：Public memorials mark where society learned painful lessons.
可用场景：文化、历史、城市介绍。

column2:
核心义：……的诞生地。
引申义：某项技术、思想、运动或制度最早出现的地方。
语气：文化/科技介绍高频。
column3:
文章语境：Cambridge is the birthplace of IVF and key biotech designs。
例句1：Universities can become the birthplace of new ideas.
例句2：The city is often described as the birthplace of modern industry.
可用场景：科技创新、文化交流、城市写作。

column2:
核心义：……的全球中心。
语气：经济/城市/科技报道常用。
搭配：a global hub for finance / culture / AI / life sciences。
column3:
文章语境：Cambridge is a global hub for life sciences, semiconductors and AI。
例句1：A city can become a global hub for innovation by attracting talent.
例句2：Universities help turn local communities into global hubs for research.
可用场景：城市发展、科技、教育、经济。

column2:
核心义：被……呼应，被……映照。
熟词辟义：echo 不只是回声，也可指相似现象在另一处出现。
语气：文雅，适合写文化联系。
column3:
文章语境：Cambridge's successes are echoed by its American namesake。
例句1：A city's educational success may be echoed by its industries.
例句2：Traditional values are echoed in modern volunteer work.
可用场景：文化交流、教育影响、历史延续。

column2:
核心义：母校。
语气：正式/文雅，有情感和身份归属意味。
常见：return to one's alma mater。
column3:
文章语境：colonists renamed the settlement to honour their alma mater。
例句1：Graduates often feel a lifelong bond with their alma mater.
例句2：A strong alma mater can connect people across countries and generations.
可用场景：教育、文化传承、身份认同。

column2:
核心义：精心设计/策划的路线。
熟词辟义：curate 原指策展，引申为筛选、组织、策划内容。
语气：文化、旅游、知识管理常用。
column3:
文章语境：a curated innovation trail 展示波士顿-剑桥创新历史。
例句1：A curated reading list can help students learn more efficiently.
例句2：Museums use curated routes to tell a coherent story.
可用场景：学习规划、文化旅游、知识管理。

column2:
核心义：被称为，被冠以……称号。
语气：新闻高频，常用于外号、称号、媒体标签。
搭配：be dubbed the world's most...
column3:
文章语境：Kendall Square is dubbed the world's most innovative square mile。
例句1：The city has been dubbed a global centre of technology.
例句2：Some students are dubbed digital natives, but they still need guidance.
可用场景：新闻阅读、城市介绍、科技文化。

column2:
核心义：主要由……驱动。
语气：正式分析句型。
搭配：be driven by demand / talent / technology / research。
column3:
文章语境：innovation engines driven primarily by academic research。
例句1：Economic growth should be driven by innovation rather than speculation.
例句2：Learning is driven primarily by curiosity and discipline.
可用场景：经济、教育、科技、个人成长。

column2:
核心义：按人均计算。
引申义：用于把不同规模地区放在同一标准下比较。
语气：数据阅读高频。
column3:
文章语境：alumni founders per person, innovation clusters per person。
例句1：Income per person is not the same as quality of life.
例句2：Reading hours per person can reflect a society's learning culture.
可用场景：图表作文、经济数据、阅读理解。

column2:
核心义：取决于你计算什么。
引申义：排名或结论受指标影响。
语气：批判数据口径，外刊常用思路。
column3:
文章语境：which Cambridge comes first depends on what you count。
例句1：Whether online learning is better depends on what you count: scores, flexibility or motivation.
例句2：A city's success depends on what you count, GDP or well-being.
可用场景：图表分析、教育评价、社会发展。

column2:
核心义：专利授权。
注意：award 这里不是奖品，而是授予/批准。
语气：科技创新和知识产权常用。
column3:
文章语境：Global Innovation Index counts patent awards。
例句1：Patent awards can reflect a country's research output.
例句2：Innovation should be measured not only by patent awards but also by social impact.
可用场景：科技创新、知识产权、经济发展。

column2:
核心义：风险投资交易。
组成：venture capital = 风投；deal = 交易/融资事件。
语气：商业外刊高频。
column3:
文章语境：WIPO 用 VC deals 衡量创新密度。
例句1：Venture-capital deals can help startups turn research into products.
例句2：Too many venture-capital deals may also create bubbles.
可用场景：经济、科技创业、商业化。

column2:
核心义：颠倒顺序。
引申义：换一个评价指标，排名结果完全不同。
语气：数据对比常用。
column3:
文章语境：Dealroom reverses the order: Boston-Cambridge wins by enterprise value and unicorns。
例句1：A different standard may reverse the order of the ranking.
例句2：If we value health more than speed, modern life may reverse the order of priorities.
可用场景：图表作文、比较论证、价值排序。

column2:
核心义：相对于，与……相比。
语气：正式，数据比较高频。
搭配：relative to population / income / size / cost。
column3:
文章语境：more patents relative to population size。
例句1：A student's progress should be judged relative to his starting point.
例句2：The cost of education is high relative to family income.
可用场景：图表、教育评价、经济阅读。

column2:
核心义：规模。
熟词辟义：不是天平/刻度，而是经济或组织规模。
引申义：规模带来的市场、人才、资本和基础设施优势。
column3:
文章语境：American Cambridge is more advanced mostly because of scale。
例句1：Scale can turn a good idea into a powerful industry.
例句2：Small schools lack scale, but they may offer closer relationships.
可用场景：经济发展、教育机构、企业成长。

column2:
核心义：在优势基础上继续发展。
语气：积极，发展策略常用。
搭配：build on strengths / success / existing advantages。
column3:
文章语境：Massachusetts has built on these advantages。
例句1：Students should build on their strengths while fixing weaknesses.
例句2：Cities can build on educational advantages to attract industry.
可用场景：学习规划、城市发展、职场成长。

column2:
核心义：资本注入。
熟词辟义：infusion 本义是注入/泡制，引申为资金、能量或信心的注入。
语气：经济报道常用。
column3:
文章语境：An infusion of capital into life sciences funded infrastructure upgrades。
例句1：An infusion of public funding can improve rural education.
例句2：A startup may grow quickly after an infusion of capital.
可用场景：经济、教育投入、科技产业。

column2:
核心义：税收激励。
引申义：政府用减税等方式鼓励企业或个人行为。
语气：政策/经济常用。
column3:
文章语境：tax incentives helped attract VC funds and pharmaceutical firms。
例句1：Tax incentives can encourage companies to invest in clean energy.
例句2：Governments may use tax incentives to support innovation.
可用场景：经济政策、环境保护、科技创新。

column2:
核心义：在某地有业务/办公室/存在感。
语气：商业报道高频，比 be in 更正式。
搭配：companies have a presence in a market/city。
column3:
文章语境：pharma companies have a presence in Cambridge。
例句1：Many global brands have a presence in China.
例句2：Universities should have a presence in public life, not only in classrooms.
可用场景：商业、城市经济、教育社会责任。

column2:
核心义：留下并扩大规模。
熟词辟义：scale 作动词表示扩大业务规模。
语气：创业/商业高频。
column3:
文章语境：Companies tend to stay and scale in American Cambridge。
例句1：Good infrastructure helps startups stay and scale.
例句2：A learner needs a method that can stay and scale with increasing difficulty.
可用场景：创业、城市发展、学习方法。

column2:
核心义：市值，market capitalisation 的缩写。
语气：金融/商业新闻常用。
理解：公司股票总价值。
column3:
文章语境：two of Britain's three biggest firms by market cap。
例句1：Market cap shows how investors value a company.
例句2：A high market cap does not always mean strong social value.
可用场景：经济阅读、公司报道、金融常识。

column2:
核心义：临时改造的实验室。
熟词辟义：makeshift = 临时凑合的，权宜的。
语气：暗示条件不足、不够专业。
column3:
文章语境：startups use office space as makeshift labs。
暗示：创新需求增长，但基础设施跟不上。
例句1：During emergencies, classrooms may become makeshift shelters.
例句2：A makeshift solution can help temporarily, but it cannot replace proper infrastructure.
可用场景：城市基础设施、应急管理、教育资源。

column2:
核心义：被……困住/限制住。
本义：hem 是衣服边，引申为被围住。
语气：形象，比 constrained 更有被挤压感。
column3:
文章语境：Hemmed in by its infrastructure, Cambridge is also starved of capital。
例句1：Students hemmed in by exam pressure may lose curiosity.
例句2：Old cities are often hemmed in by limited land and transport systems.
可用场景：教育压力、城市发展、个人成长。

column2:
核心义：风险投资部门。
熟词辟义：arm 不只是手臂，也指机构的分支部门。
语气：商业报道常用。
column3:
文章语境：GV, Google's venture arm。
例句1：A university may create a venture arm to support student startups.
例句2：The charity's research arm studies public health problems.
可用场景：商业、组织结构、科技创业。

column2:
核心义：换句话说，以另一种方式表达。
语气：解释、转述、推进论证常用。
搭配：To put it differently,...
column3:
文章语境：Allan Bradley puts it differently 后接更尖锐的说法。
例句1：To put it differently, discipline is freedom in the long run.
例句2：To put it differently, technology is useful only when people use it wisely.
可用场景：作文改写、口语解释、论证推进。

column2:
核心义：因过剩而被扭曲。
语气：批评性，常用于资本、信息、欲望、竞争过度。
反差：英国缺乏，美国过剩。
column3:
文章语境：American twin has been distorted by excess。
例句1：Education can be distorted by excessive competition.
例句2：A market may be distorted by too much cheap capital.
可用场景：教育竞争、资本泡沫、消费主义。

column2:
核心义：首次公开募股，公司上市。
外刊常见：have an IPO / file for an IPO / IPO market。
语气：金融新闻基础词。
column3:
文章语境：companies began to have IPOs way too early。
例句1：An IPO can give a company access to public capital markets.
例句2：A premature IPO may expose a weak business model.
可用场景：经济阅读、公司新闻、创业。

column2:
核心义：猛增，飙升。
本义：鸟向高处飞。
语气：新闻高频，用于价格、成本、数量、期待等急剧上升。
column3:
文章语境：Rents, overhead costs and salary expectations all soared。
例句1：Housing prices have soared in many big cities.
例句2：Students' anxiety may soar before important exams.
可用场景：经济、住房、教育压力、健康心理。

column2:
核心义：下行期，衰退，低迷。
语气：经济金融高频。
搭配：economic downturn / market downturn。
column3:
文章语境：When the downturn came, lab space was vacant and funding stopped。
例句1：During an economic downturn, young workers need adaptable skills.
例句2：A downturn can expose weaknesses hidden during rapid growth.
可用场景：经济生活、职场发展、风险管理。

column2:
核心义：空置的，空缺的。
熟词场景：vacant room / vacant position / vacant lab space。
语气：房地产、职场、经济常用。
column3:
文章语境：28% of lab space was vacant。
例句1：Many offices remain vacant after the rise of remote work.
例句2：A vacant position can create opportunities for young employees.
可用场景：职场、房地产、经济变化。

column1: as X halted, so did Y
column2:
核心义：随着 X 停下，Y 也停下。
语法：so did Y 是倒装，表示“Y 也如此”。
语气：简洁、有节奏，适合描述连锁反应。
column3:
文章语境：As the cranes halted, so did the funding。建筑停了，资金也停了。
例句1：As curiosity faded, so did learning motivation.
例句2：As public trust declined, so did cooperation.
可用场景：长难句、作文句式、因果连锁。

column2:
核心义：把更大金额投给更少公司。
引申义：资源集中，强者更强，早期弱者更难。
语气：经济/资源分配分析。
column3:
文章语境：Investors became risk-averse, giving larger amounts to fewer firms。
例句1：Scholarships sometimes give larger amounts to fewer students, leaving others unsupported.
例句2：In a downturn, capital often goes to safer, larger firms.
可用场景：教育公平、经济资源、社会分配。

column2:
核心义：与……正好相反。
语气：对比论证高频。
搭配：the reverse of the British problem。
column3:
文章语境：美国早期公司缺资本，是英国问题的反面。
例句1：Too much control can be as harmful as too little; it is simply the reverse of the same problem.
例句2：Rural schools face the reverse of urban schools' difficulties.
可用场景：对比论证、教育、社会问题。

column2:
核心义：在纳斯达克上市。
熟词辟义：list 不是列清单，而是股票上市。
语气：商业金融常用。
column3:
文章语境：Bicycle Therapeutics listed on the Nasdaq in 2019。
例句1：A company listed on a major exchange can raise more capital.
例句2：Being listed abroad may give startups access to deeper markets.
可用场景：经济阅读、创业、资本市场。

column2:
核心义：核心研发。
搭配：R&D = research and development。
语气：科技和公司报道基础表达。
column3:
文章语境：keep core R&D at home, open office in Massachusetts。
例句1：A country should protect its core research and development capacity.
例句2：Universities contribute to core research and development in many industries.
可用场景：科技创新、教育、国家战略。

column2:
核心义：便宜地，以低成本方式。
语气：口语/新闻，有一点轻松甚至尖锐。
注意：不是 cheap quality，而是 low cost。
column3:
文章语境：the latter offers world-class talent on the cheap。英国提供相对便宜的世界级人才。
暗示：英国人才强，但市场定价低。
例句1：Online courses can offer high-quality learning on the cheap.
例句2：Companies sometimes seek talent on the cheap in weaker labour markets.
可用场景：教育资源、职场、经济生活。

column2:
核心义：朝相反方向流动。
语气：资金、人才、信息、文化流动常用。
搭配：capital/talent/data flows in the opposite direction。
column3:
文章语境：Capital is flowing in the opposite direction: US investors invest in British Cambridge。
例句1：Talent may flow in the opposite direction when policies change.
例句2：Cultural influence does not move one way; it can flow in the opposite direction.
可用场景：文化交流、人才流动、资本市场。

column2:
核心义：卓越中心，优势集聚地。
语气：机构宣传、产业政策常用。
引申义：某地在特定领域有顶尖能力。
column3:
文章语境：British Cambridge is a centre of excellence。
例句1：A university can become a centre of excellence in sports science.
例句2：Cities need centres of excellence to attract investment and talent.
可用场景：教育、科技、城市发展、职业规划。

column2:
核心义：对冲，防范……风险。
熟词辟义：hedge 不只是树篱，也指风险对冲。
语气：金融/风险管理常用。
column3:
文章语境：investment in British Cambridge is a hedge against Kendall Square downturn。
例句1：Learning transferable skills is a hedge against job-market uncertainty.
例句2：Saving money can be a hedge against unexpected illness.
可用场景：职场、经济、风险管理、备考规划。

column2:
核心义：与……连接/联合起来。
语气：合作和网络建设常用。
区别：比 cooperate with 更强调连成一体。
column3:
文章语境：British Cambridge wants to learn from and join up with its namesake。
例句1：Schools should join up with communities to support students.
例句2：Cities can join up with universities to build innovation networks.
可用场景：教育合作、城市发展、文化交流。

column2:
核心义：以……为模型，仿照……设计。
语气：正式，制度/建筑/项目设计常用。
搭配：be modelled on a successful system。
column3:
文章语境：innovation hub modelled on LabCentral。
例句1：A new training programme can be modelled on proven methods.
例句2：Education reform should not be blindly modelled on foreign systems.
可用场景：教育改革、制度设计、科技园区。

column2:
核心义：加快临床试验。
组成：speed up = 加快；clinical trials = 临床试验。
语气：医学、药物研发常用。
column3:
文章语境：universities and health providers work on speeding up clinical trials。
例句1：AI may help speed up clinical trials and drug discovery.
例句2：Better cooperation can speed up public-service reform.
可用场景：健康、科技、社会责任、医学创新。

column2:
核心义：……方面的紧张/压力。
熟词辟义：squeeze 本义挤压，引申为供应紧张或压力。
搭配：the squeeze on housing / space / budgets。
column3:
文章语境：The squeeze on lab space is easing。实验室空间紧张正在缓解。
例句1：The squeeze on family budgets can affect children's education.
例句2：The squeeze on urban housing makes young workers anxious.
可用场景：经济生活、住房、教育资源、城市发展。

column2:
核心义：加速推进。
本义/诙谐：steam 与火车蒸汽有关，文章谈铁路项目时有轻微双关。
语气：新闻标题式表达。
column3:
文章语境：railway project may finally steam ahead。谈铁路时用 steam ahead，带一点文字游戏。
例句1：After years of delay, the education reform may finally steam ahead.
例句2：Once funding is secured, the project can steam ahead.
可用场景：项目推进、政策改革、新闻表达。

column2:
核心义：深化资本市场。
引申义：让金融市场更成熟、更有资金深度、更能支持企业成长。
语气：经济政策表达。
column3:
文章语境：Pension reforms may help Britain deepen its capital markets。
例句1：Deep capital markets can support long-term innovation.
例句2：A country needs patient investors to deepen capital markets.
可用场景：经济、科技创业、政策阅读。

column2:
核心义：大幅削减公共经费。
熟词辟义：slash 作动词/名词表示猛砍、削减。
语气：强烈，带批评意味。
column3:
文章语境：America's slashing of public research funding hurt Boston-Cambridge。
例句1：The slashing of education budgets can damage equal opportunity.
例句2：Public health suffers when funding is slashed too quickly.
可用场景：教育、科研、公共服务、社会责任。

column2:
核心义：创新的地理版图。
引申义：创新中心在哪里、如何转移、哪些地区崛起。
语气：外刊宏观分析表达。
column3:
文章语境：The geography of innovation is shifting。创新中心可能从剑桥转向深圳等地。
例句1：The geography of innovation changes when talent and capital move.
例句2：Digital tools may reshape the geography of education.
可用场景：科技、经济、城市发展、国际竞争。

column2:
核心义：使 A 更加靠近/更紧密。
引申义：外部压力促成合作。
语气：国际关系、组织合作常用。
column3:
文章语境：competition from China may draw the Cambridges closer still。
例句1：Shared challenges can draw different communities closer.
例句2：Global problems should draw countries closer, not push them apart.
可用场景：文化交流、国际合作、社会责任。
